notes: Every receipt gets a receipt code on its placard and its own license plate (switchable under Settings → General → Receiving). Receiving → Undo a receipt: scan the code, say why, and everything it booked comes off the ledger with your comment. Locations shows every location at once, and Reports → Locations lists them all. New roles: Manager, Pick & pack, Receiving and PPD lead. Kits in the portal say Made to order.
